refnamediv.refpurpose: Evaluate a SilikoNode with a SilikoEngine

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The SilikoEvaluate function evaluates node using engine to resolve operators and function calls.

refsection.title: Return Values
refsection.para: Returns the value obtained by evaluating the tree. Error values will propogate based on the rules within functions called during evaluation. Siliko Core's built-in functions normally return the first error they encounter when evaluating from left to right.
